title: Exports with no rows still download a file with only the headings
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Location-A} has no invoices on {Date-A}.
    For example: {Date-A} is 1 Jan 2026.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Set the date range to {Date-A}.
  2. With all three Sales Types selected, export the CSV.
  3. Export the PDF.
  4. Open Reports > Sales By Customer.
  5. Set the date range to {Date-A}.
  6. With both Sales Types selected, export the CSV.
  7. Export the PDF.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report shows {Date-A} with no invoices.
  • Step 2: "Empty export" does not show; a CSV downloads with the filter line "Sales Type: All", the column headings and no rows.
  • Step 3: a PDF downloads with the filter line "Sales Type: All", the column headings and no rows.
  • Step 4: the Sales By Customer report opens.
  • Step 5: the report shows {Date-A} with no invoices.
  • Step 6: "Empty export" does not show; a CSV downloads with the filter line "Sales Type: All Sales", the column headings and no rows.
  • Step 7: a PDF downloads with the filter line "Sales Type: All Sales", the column headings and no rows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R4: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Representative reads the same: "Sales Type: All", or the selected names. With no option selected there is nothing to export: Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. Any other export with no rows, for example a date range with no invoices, still downloads a file with the headings and no rows, as today.”
  • S8-R9: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Customer reads "Sales Type: All Sales", "Sales Type: Part Sales only", or "Sales Type: Service Sales only". With no option selected, Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. Any other export with no rows still downloads a file with the headings and no rows, as today.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 27: “27. (a) as the feature spec on both reports. Other empty results still download a file with headings and no rows, unchanged.”
